title: antillanthus carinatus
intro: Antillanthus carinatus, commonly known as the Puerto Rican cudweed, is a plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including inflammation and infections, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Antillanthus carinatus include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its role in wound healing, which is attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils. Further research is needed to fully understand the therapeutic potential of Antillanthus carinatus and its bioactive constituents.
